stories.title: Colapinto 5-Place Penalty — Norris Demands Race Ban

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Franco Colapinto gets a 5-place grid penalty for the Malaysia GP after his restart crash at Baku that took out Norris and Gasly on Lap 36.

Norris: "If you cause a crash on a restart like this, you should have at least a one-race ban."

Alpine is reviewing its "course of action."

x_posts.label: Post 1B
x_posts.text:
George Russell on whether Colapinto deserved a race ban after Baku:

"I think a race ban would have been too harsh."

Lando Norris disagrees. Alpine is still deciding what happens next to Colapinto's seat.

stories.title: Antonelli Singapore Math — 66 Points Clear, Title Could Come at Marina Bay

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli can clinch the 2026 F1 title at Singapore on October 11.

The scenario: win the Sprint, win the race, Russell finishes outside the points.

If it happens, he'd be the youngest champion in F1 history. He's 20 years old.

x_posts.label: Post 2B
x_posts.text:
F1 standings after Baku:

Antonelli: 302 pts
Russell: 236 pts
Gap: 66 pts
Rounds left: 9

First clinch window: Singapore, Oct 9-11. Singapore also runs its first-ever Sprint this year.

stories.title: Malaysia GP Preview — Sepang Returns to F1 After Nine Years

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
F1 returns to Sepang for the first time since 2017.

The Malaysia GP is October 2-4. Colapinto takes a 5-place penalty. Verstappen goes hunting after finishing 0.196s back at Baku.

Sepang: 5.543km, 15 corners, 56 laps.

x_posts.label: Post 3B
x_posts.text:
Nine years.

That's how long it's been since F1 last raced at Sepang International Circuit.

Malaysia is back on the calendar October 2-4 for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix -- one of F1's most iconic venues.

He won. He closed the gap by 15 points. It still looks very steep.
